## Purpose
The header indicator for background runs: what is still going, and what finished while the user was elsewhere.

## Responsibilities
- A popover lists the runs (`RunRow`) with status, progress and links, plus "clear finished".
- The badge shows the average progress of the measurable running runs, and the unseen endings.

## Key elements
